instruction: Cinematic medium shot inside an indoor boxing ring. On the left, the woman in the black and orange jumpsuit (R1) stands facing right, holding up a red focus mitt with a focused expression. On the right, the woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands facing left, her left arm extended with her black boxing glove resting against the mitt of the woman in the black and orange jumpsuit. The background features dark hanging punching bags under cool, dim overhead gym lighting.

R1 is the pad holder while R2 is the striker
